nodes.name: Load Pending Source B File Runs

parameters.content:
## Module 3 -- Source B Ingest + Reconcile
Pulls e-commerce JSON orders, matches them to existing canonical_lines (from Module 2), and resolves cross-source conflicts per client_config.field_precedence_json. See Reconcile Source B Rows node comment for the full precedence + matching rule.

## Before running
1. Fill client_config.source_b_field_map_json, order_ref_normalize_b_json, field_precedence_json for each client.
2. Open 'Parse Source B JSON' and set ROOT_PATH to match your real file shape.
3. Test on ONE file first (limit Load Pending Source B File Runs, or pin data).

## Conflict handling
Both values are ALWAYS preserved (conflict_values_json + Exceptions row) even when precedence picks a winner for the canonical field. Nothing is silently overwritten.
